name: Kryterion Inc
client_reviews: Proctors find the global testing environment to be stimulating and professional, although some employees report occasional inconsistencies in technical support and quality assurance.

name: Lab Express
client_reviews: Contractors generally report positive experiences with Lab Express, citing reliable daily pay and flexible routing options.

name: Gigwalk
client_reviews: Offers a highly flexible on-demand model for secret shopping and retail audits, but gig availability can be inconsistent for users outside of major metropolitan hubs.

name: American Expediting
client_reviews: Contractors praise American Expediting for its reliable payment structure and varied route opportunities across the US and Canada.

name: Rapid Medical
client_reviews: Contractors praise Rapid Medical for reliable routes and flexible scheduling, but note that pay could be higher for the level of expertise required

name: TrendSource
client_reviews: Praised for a supportive and non-judgmental environment for supplemental income earners, though some contractors report slow payment cycles and unorganized management communication.

name: Second To None
client_reviews: Contractors praise Second To None for their clear guidelines and prompt payment, but some find the evaluation criteria to be overly stringent at times.

name: USInspect
client_reviews: Contractors generally report a smooth hiring process and flexible scheduling opportunities with USInspect.

name: Reotrans.com / equator.com
client_reviews: Contractors generally report positive experiences with Reotrans.com / equator.com, citing timely payments and a wide range of available work orders.

name: IntelliShop
client_reviews: IntelliShop pays consistently and has a user-friendly platform, but the evaluation work can be sporadic at times
